title: Add default-app play actions for output files
summary: Adds selected-row Play actions for Completed output files and Pending Publish parked outputs using backend-owned row-key open routes.
reason: Operators need a direct way to play final and parked output files in the PC default media player without sending raw filesystem paths from the WebView.
behavior_before: Selected output actions could open backend-selected media paths, but generic media opens preferred VLC when available and the Pending Publish selected row exposed only a generic local-file open action.
behavior_after: Selected Completed and Pending Publish rows expose explicit Play actions that resolve backend-owned paths and launch them through the operating-system default file association while preserving existing Open actions.
